kurz: Dried beans, lentils and chickpeas need water, time and heat before their skins and cell walls soften.
bild_im_kopf: Like a seed in spring: first water, then it comes back to life and softens.
was_passiert: Soaking lets the dried seeds take up water. Cooking dissolves the glue between the cells (pectin) and gelatinises the starch. Acid and calcium keep the cell walls firm; baking soda and salt soften them.
warum_wichtig: Knowing what softens pulses and what keeps them hard means never again waiting for hours on tough beans.
faustregeln: Soak beans and chickpeas, not lentils.
Add acid such as tomato or wine only once they are soft.
Always boil kidney beans hard for at least 10 minutes.
